Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund
Sponsor: Elliott
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 11/01/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 9 as introduced will increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Department of Labor and the Office of the Attorney General, by an undetermined amount, to publish guidelines for employees with regard to the provisions of this bill. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Greg Albritton, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation General Fund

Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund
Sponsor: Elliott
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 11/01/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 9 as introduced will increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Department of Labor and the Office of the Attorney General, by an undetermined amount, to publish guidelines for employees with regard to the provisions of this bill. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
As substituted and reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation General Fund, this bill removes the requirement for the Department of Labor and the Office of the Attorney General to publish guidelines and increases the administrative obligations of the Department of Labor to adjudicate medical or religious exemptions for employees that have been terminated if the employee refuses a COVID-19 vaccine.
Greg Albritton, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation General Fund

Committee: Health
Sponsor: Elliott
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 11/03/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 9 as passed the Senate requires an employer to allow an individual to claim an exemption from COVID-19 vaccinations for medical reasons or religious beliefs. This bill would increase the administrative obligations of the Department of Labor to adjudicate claims by employers seeking to terminate individuals seeking such exemptions.
Paul W. Lee, Chair
Health
